figurative_meaning_en: broad daylight, midday, openly in the light of day
example_sentences_in_bangla: দিনদুপুরে এমন অপরাধ করা সাহসের কাজ।
সবাই দেখতে পেল যখন দিনদুপুরে চুরি হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: Committing such a crime in broad daylight takes guts.
Everyone saw the theft happen in broad daylight.
history: This idiom originates from Bengali proverbs highlighting the audacity of crimes like robbery committed openly during the day, emphasizing lack of fear or hiding.
note: Often used to describe bold or brazen actions without concealment.
